prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it, take it, check it, then do a task. If not visible, scan for it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = MoveToGoal    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
		DO GrabObject
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
